title: Moving with the Times: Predictive Drift Correction of Multi-frame STEM
content: Collecting many frames is often necessary in electron microscopy, for example in-situ dynamic imaging. But sample drift during a series acquisition may reduce the usable common area after alignment. Where significant drift is present, or during longer in-situ acquisitions, the feature of interest may even drift entirely out of the view. Here we use image correlation to diagnose and log this drift during acquisition. By predicting the stage drift for the next frame yet to be recorded, this foresight is used with a custom scan generator to scan over the same physical area every time.
